analysis: Observed input prefix and arrival structure; CPU only

cohort.name: observed_root_api
cohort.rule: all requests in observed-root parent components containing only type=api

methods.history: strictly earlier cohort inputs; 0 < age <= window; unlimited has no age cap
methods.time_arithmetic: Decimal(str(source timestamp)) subtraction for window boundaries and reported ages; original legacy fields retain historical float arithmetic
methods.fraction_denominator: original input token count, including partial-block tokens
methods.scopes: all / within same observed parent component / another component; maxima not additive
methods.high_low_groups: current unlimited-history overlap >=0.5 versus <0.5; disjoint requests
methods.chain_incidence: event chains / chains with any request in the same group and stratum; groups can share chains
methods.strata: time, prompt length, turn, and joint; context/history remain full-cohort
methods.significance: none; dependencies and confounding prevent independent-request interpretation
methods.completion_cache_and_latency: unobserved; no inference or cache simulation
methods.standardization: Descriptive high-minus-low contrast weighted to the combined request distribution of joint time/length/turn strata with >=30 requests per group. Coverage is explicit; coarse adjustment cannot eliminate confounding.
